notes: Fixed CreateLearningSpaceHandler to use intermediate type casts (Created<T>, BadRequest<T>, ProblemHttpResult) instead of direct casts to the Results<T1,T2,T3> union type, resolving InvalidCastException in 5 presentation tests. Fixed EF configuration to ignore client-assigned LearningSpaceId on insert (SetBeforeSaveBehavior Ignore) so the database IDENTITY column generates the ID, resolving e2e POST probe failure.
